<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>x_2223823_apollo_0_appointment</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Create Consultation Charge Line</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous) {

    var charge = new GlideRecord('x_2223823_apollo_0_charge_line');

    // Prevent duplicate consultation charge
    charge.addQuery('source_table', current.getTableName());
    charge.addQuery('source_record', current.getUniqueValue());
    charge.addQuery('charge_type', 'consultation');
    charge.query();

    if (charge.next()) {
        return;
    }

    charge.initialize();

    charge.setValue('hospital', current.getValue('hospital'));
    charge.setValue('patient', current.getValue('patient'));
    charge.setValue('invoice', current.getValue('invoice'));

    // Change this field to your actual consultation fee field
    charge.setValue('amount', current.getValue('fee'));
    
    charge.setValue('charge_type', 'consultation');
    charge.setValue('status', 'invoiced');

    charge.setValue('description', 'Consultation Charge');
    charge.setValue('source_table', current.getTableName());
    charge.setValue('source_record', current.getUniqueValue());

    charge.insert();

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>ayush.mangal</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-16 05:52:42</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>25028c5a47a85b50273a565a516d4382</sys_id><sys_mod_count>3</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Create Consultation Charge Line</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Apollo-Hospitals" source="x_2223823_apollo_0">87c1422693c89b507b3a7c5efaba1008</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Apollo-Hospitals">87c1422693c89b507b3a7c5efaba1008</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_25028c5a47a85b50273a565a516d4382</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>ayush.mangal</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-16 10:46:35</sys_updated_on><template/><when>after</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=25028c5a47a85b50273a565a516d4382"/></record_update>
